title: Leaving Allen for the Old Kentucky Minstrels
summary: After about four months, still not playing, he moved to the Old Kentucky Minstrels in the Carolinas to move up toward New York.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I see. That's a pretty reasonable price. While you were with A.G. Allen's, all that you did was pretty much the walking gent.
I see. So you didn't play any music.
Not until I was round about...oh, about six... About six months later.
You said you joined the Old Kentucky Minstrels after about four months. So this would be sometime, I guess, around 1915.
You were still maybe about fourteen years old.
And how long were you with the Old Kentucky Minstrels?
The Old Kentucky Minstrels... I'd say about two months.
What caused you, first of all, to leave A.G. Allen's and go to the Old Kentucky group?

I wanted to move up. A.G. Allen just played right down South all the time. But I wanted... All my main ambition was to get to New York. But I didn't come to New York with no minstrel show. I picked the Old Kentucky Minstrels down in South Carolina or somewhere down in there. That's the last one.
